name: Magician

pf.license.business: No trade license for a magician. Business registration where the state's form asks for it; identity checked; 'license: what the business says'.
pf.license.person: None. Where a school, a camp or a venue asks for a background check before working with children, it's a certificate the plug-in names (kept with its date and renew-by), never a license.
pf.license.insurance: The performer's own liability insurance. A venue that asks for proof of insurance gets it from the business's own tools (Rosie doesn't send it).

pf.services.name: Kids' birthday magic show
pf.services.example: $350 for 45 minutes, up to 30 kids (the example performer's own price)
pf.services.length: 45 minutes, plus 30 minutes to set up before
pf.services.where: B: the customer's home or a venue they book (a park pavilion, a party room)
pf.services.money: B: a $100 deposit when booking; the $250 rest after the show, on the bill Rosie sends, or cash the performer's own way

pf.services.name: Strolling magic for a company or wedding event
pf.services.money: B: a $450 deposit when booking; the $450 rest on the bill after the event

pf.services.name: Balloon twisting add-on
pf.services.where: B, added at booking or at the party

pf.services.name: Virtual magic show by video
pf.services.example: $300 for 40 minutes, for a group online
pf.services.money: A: the full price when booking

pf.services.name: Private magic lesson
pf.services.money: A: a card saved for a $40 late-cancel fee; paid at the lesson

pf.questions.before_times: The date and start time of the event (a need-by date: the show must happen that day); the kind of event (a child's party, a company event, a wedding); about how many guests and the children's age range (sets the show); indoors or outdoors; the town or ZIP (travel area).
pf.questions.after_time: Name and mobile; the venue's address and who meets the performer; where the show will be set up; whether the venue allows small fire effects.
pf.questions.secure_page_only: Any guest's allergy that matters for the show (latex balloons, animal fur); a child's name for the birthday call-out.
pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult (the host, a parent, or an organization's planner). A teen can't book alone.

pf.safety.stop_words: A medical emergency at the party; a fire; a threat to the performer or guests.
pf.safety.show_safety: No fire or flash effects without the venue's OK and never near children's hair or decorations; no live animal when a guest is allergic; no latex balloons when a guest has a latex allergy (the performer brings latex-free or skips them).
pf.safety.what_rosie_says: 911 first in an emergency. Allergy answers stay on the secure page and reach only the performer.
pf.safety.booking_goes_on: Yes for allergies (the show adapts); no booking during an emergency.

pf.first_steps.required: Events: the performance agreement signed on the secure page when booking (the date, start time, length, price, deposit and cancel terms). Lessons and video shows: none.
pf.first_steps.prep: A clear space about 10 by 10 feet with the audience seated in front; one small table; an outlet within 20 feet for the sound system; the birthday child's first name for the show.

pf.visit.B: The performer arrives 30 minutes before the set start to set up; the host or the person they name gives the check-in code at arrival; an adult host stays responsible for the children the whole time (the performer never takes care of a child); extras asked at the party (more time, balloons) are priced first and done only on the customer's own yes; DONE at the end.
pf.visit.A: Video show: the code at the start of the call. Lesson: the code at the studio desk.
pf.visit.done_proof: DONE from the performer (B); the code (A).

pf.money.ways: Events: a deposit when booking (a share of the price), the rest after the show on the bill Rosie sends, or the business's own way (cash or check on the day). Video shows: the full price when booking. Lessons: a card saved for the fee, paid at the lesson.
pf.money.fees: One fee per booking: events keep the deposit when cancelled inside 14 days (the owner's yes); lessons $40 inside 24 hours.
pf.money.tips: A tip line on the bills Rosie sends (the owner's setting).
pf.money.travel: A travel fee for towns farther than the travel area, shown in the first price.
pf.money.rosfield: $2 per booking (not a health practice or a law firm).

pf.messages.never_in_text: A guest's allergy or health need; a child's details beyond the first name the host gives for the show.

pf.staff.skills: Each performer has their own shows. The customer books a named performer for an event; a stand-in only where the booking didn't name one, and never on silence.
pf.staff.alone: Performers work alone at events: an emergency contact is required for the check-out timer.
pf.staff.children: Never left alone in charge of children; the host's adult stays.

pf.rules.agreement: Events: a signed performance agreement before the date (the business's own terms).
pf.rules.cancel: Free cancel until 14 days before the event; after that the deposit may be kept, with the owner's yes. One move to another date is the owner's choice.
pf.rules.venue: A venue someone else controls: the customer confirms the venue allows the show and any effects.

pf.edges.a sick performer: the one 'can't give it' path; a named performer is never swapped on silence
pf.edges.rain at an outdoor party: the host moves it inside or it's a customer cancel; Rosie never decides weather
pf.edges.the party runs late or the start moves o: the performer's set start stands; more time is an extra the customer OKs
pf.edges.a guest's allergy: secure page only; the performer adapts the show
pf.edges.a child hurt during the show: the host's adult and 911 first; the owner told at once
pf.edges.only children at the door: the performer waits for the host adult
